notes.title: Free demo for Sanctuary - coming next year!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Some very exciting news!

Sanctuary will have a demo, for free! This demo will launch early next year, at the same time as our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/enhearten-media/sanctuary-shattered-sun]Kickstarter campaign[/url].

However, you can wishlist the demo right now on Steam! This will get you on the list for playtests and notify you when it is released. So please do that as it helps us get noticed on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2375120

We have also recently patched the pre-alpha build, currently available to our wonderful patreon supporters who help make all this happen, and are releasing a [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KsKWTJPR_ag]developer Q&A on our youtube channel[/url] where we answer your questions.

Thank you for all of your love and support,
The dev team at Enhearten Media

notes.title: Development Update - October 2024
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

There have been lots of exciting developments in the past few months, and we are very excited to share our progress with you.

Let’s start with the big news in case you haven't heard it already: We've reached a big milestone earlier this year with a pre-alpha demo of the game! It is currently available for closed testing through our Patreon channel. The feedback we've received so far has been fantastic and we are so happy you seem to be enjoying the game! Since then we have been working hard on it and updated it with new maps, units, UI upgrades and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/ee7a7e84a36bdb39402394a8b80c4dcbab27c972.jpg[/img]

There is still a lot of work to do, and we are maintaining our "when its done" attitude for the game, so no hard release dates just yet!

In the meantime, here is some more stuff we have in the pipeline at the moment - we are doing a lot of work behind the scenes, so here are some screenshots from the game for you to look at:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/2e5edde5e81f86d88d5fb2357c7e2681ad3a99f8.jpg[/img]
We start with one of our recent visual updates for the tier 4 resource generator for the Guard faction. We always try to put a lot of effort into making these high tier structures feel appropriately impressive, which can be a challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/bfd554f5f89faabccd760f1ac97f7ce5ec3be539.jpg[/img]
We've also been looking at our aircraft - adding vapour trails and engine exhausts. It's these details that help bring the units to life and add a bit of extra polish to the game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/f4a31e48de89e5cf7cd5f056861bee9649b5afaa.jpg[/img]
We have also been adding units into the game - here are some of them that are being worked on - try guessing what they do!

There is too much to include in this post, so head on over to [url=https://discord.gg/sanctuaryshatteredsun]our discord server[/url] for all the latest news and info.


Looking ahead, our team is putting in a lot of resources towards optimisation and core systems. While this means fewer visible changes in the near future, this is very important groundwork that will make sure that the game runs smoothly, reliably, and can support all of our planned features. We have already made some great progress on many systems, but there is still a lot of work left to do - after all for an RTS like this it’s essential to get all the technology right, not just the shiny explosions.

Thanks for your continued support and patience as we work toward making this game the best it can be. We'll have more updates to share as development progresses.

The very best regards,
The dev team at Enhearten Media

notes.title: Sanctuary Shattered Sun at PAX East & GDC 2024
notes.content:
Last year, we showed off our game demo in Australia - it went so well that we are going to do it again! This time at [b]Pax East[/b] in March this year! There we will exhibit Sanctuary - and give you a chance to [b]play the demo before everyone else![/b] If you want to see that then be sure to stop by!

But what's more - we will be stopping by [b]GDC 2024[/b] in San Francisco for a couple of days, so you have a chance to meet us there if you are in the area!

Check out the key dates below and we can't wait to see you!

[u]Here is our schedule:[/u]
[b]Game Developers Conference 2024[/b]
[b]Dates:[/b] March 18th to 19th, 2024
[b]Location:[/b]Moscone Center, San Francisco
 
[b]Pax East 2024[/b]
[b]Dates:[/b] March 21st to 24th, 2024
[b]Location:[/b] Boston Convention & Exhibition Center - Booth number 16085

What are you waiting for? Book those tickets now and check us out, tell all of your friends! See the game and meet our team, who will love to answer all of your questions, talk about the game, and just hang out!

If you can't make it to Pax to play the demo - please be patient! We know that everyone is waiting for a demo of the game they can play!

We want to make sure that the game is of a high quality and lives up to your expectations, and we are working hard to make that happen! But as always, these things take time and the last thing we want to do is rush out something half baked. Pax is a chance for us to show you what we have so far without needing to take into consideration various difficulties with deploying games to lots of different PCs and setups. This way, we can show you the game earlier than would be possible otherwise!

We know that it has been a long journey so far, and we are making heaps of progress every day thanks to your support! So thank you so much for believing in us and in Sanctuary!

See you all soon!

notes.title: Development Update - February 2024
notes.content:
Hey there everyone!

It has been a while since our last update, but we've been working hard behind the scenes of Sanctuary: Shattered Sun and we want to share with you some of the improvements we made. 

As always, we have been adding new units to the game as we go along, so here are a few of them for you to look at. The Guard faction has some impressive turnout, and here are some you may not have seen before:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/4adfbc65a4243ab355a43bb5870de57890da5afd.jpg[/img]

If you've been browsing our Discord or social media you may have seen some of these, but here they are in a bit more detail in case you missed them! We have some grenade artillery bots, some hover tanks, various new structures in the background, and of course the start of the show - the huge and menacing Titan we added not too long ago!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/3aaf06ff32c35814a6ba76899ef602ed63dff3e2.jpg[/img]
Next we have a unit with a new game mechanic we've mentioned in the past - the combat drone launcher! This building will launch attack drones at its targets that will shoot on them for you from quite some distance! Be careful though, the enemy can shoot down these drones with some defensive structures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/4a97d6c35f5e7f4f38865d4bf04855b7649d1812.jpg[/img]
And here is one of these aforementioned defensive structures! These aren’t able to damage normal units, but are fantastic against drones. Try to guess how this one will work, it’s far from obvious! Good luck!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/6d07cb7bce04e542a5758ed491bfe974a02fb1ec.jpg[/img]
Next we just wanted to share this update to our Chosen titan unit. We've had this model for a while (you can see it in our cinematic trailer!) But we've recently updated it and given it some extra polish and detail. Now you can admire it up close!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/b9fb200dbee8cbf9537ed71a99b51f51786f6e64.jpg[/img]
Just to put it into perspective of how huge it is, here it is again dwarfing units around it. Check out its many barrels and turrets - those are full sized heavy weapons on there and it makes them look tiny!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/928ce10a44cb9fb380feb9055fc3cf1c06cade67.jpg[/img]
And lastly we have been working hard on the UI for the game - here is a mockup image we put together. It's still a work in progress, but we have most of that working in the game right now! We wanted to make sure the UI doesn’t interfere with the most important element on the screen - the game itself - and so we are trying to make something that’s not too intrusive, but still easy to read and work out what’s going on. The UI is scaleable and supports 4K screens. This (as is everything!) is still subject to change so your feedback is appreciated!

That’s all we have for now, but we have some more exciting news coming very soon so be sure to check back here often!

What would help us in the meantime is if you wishlist Sanctuary: Shattered Sun. We are an indie studio and so sharing the game around and promoting it to the Steam algorithm helps us a huge deal. All of you have been amazing so far and we can’t wait to get the game into your hands as soon as we can!

If you want to see news far more often and ask us questions, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/sanctuaryshatteredsun]Discord Here[/url]. We will be happy to see you and can answer any of your questions there. Bring your friends, too!

notes.title: Sanctuary Shattered Sun at PAX Australia 2023
notes.content:
We are thrilled to share some exciting news with you: Our upcoming participation at PAX Australia 2023 in Melbourne!
Our highly anticipated game will be making its debut appearance from October 6th to 8th, 2023. This marks a significant milestone for our team, and we couldn't be more excited to be a part of this prestigious gaming event.

And if this wasn't exciting enough, a playable demo version of the game will be exclusively available at our booth during the event. This will be your chance to be among the first to experience the captivating world of Sanctuary Shattered Sun firsthand. Get ready to be among the first players to immerse themselves in our stunning visuals and engaging gameplay.
 

[b][u]Here are the details:[/u]
Event: PAX Australia 2023 
Dates: October 6th to 8th, 2023 
Location: Melbourne Convention and Exhibition Centre, Booth 26[/b]
 

We invite you to visit our booth and meet our team, who will be on hand to answer any questions, provide insights into the game, and share our development journey with you.

This wouldn't have been possible without the unwavering support of our amazing community, and we can't wait to share this experience with you.


Thank you for being a part of our journey! We look forward to seeing you at PAX Australia 2023.

notes.title: Development Update - June 2023
notes.content:
Hey there everyone!

We've been putting in the hours on Sanctuary: Shattered Sun and we're excited to show you what we've been up to. New units have been added to the game, bringing greater diversity and strategic depth. Here's some images of just some of the units we have been adding:

The Guard faction has had over a dozen units added in recent time, and here are just a couple of them.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/b3430d069e8dfe23092eb698b6e3212f10764137.jpg[/img]
The Chosen have also seen some new units, among them is this tier 4 hovering bot! Shown next to the commander for scale!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/68c824c32514e727a68d353c97a290d986b69b94.jpg[/img]


We've expanded the horizons of our Dyson Sphere with the addition of new environments, like snowy mountains and sprawling deserts. Here's a glimpse:

Sweltering desert is first! This also shows off our decals system which adds a lot of detail. So far we have been making maps without any decals!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/ec909f0dea1575a85c1d153e3090bd56d0429e88.jpg[/img]

And an icy landscape next - This image also shows off our new skyboxes, and infinite terrain technology making it look like the map goes on forever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/384be277200b3c2fe11132f8c833edcc91ff1c6d.jpg[/img]

Lastly, we have upgraded our existing maps, including better lighting, terrain, and textures. Check out this:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43239949/6e7480bd7fc1a278bdeebc544e4f05beb31ad4f7.jpg[/img]

Thats it for now, stay tuned for further updates - we have lots of exciting things under wraps that we can't wait to share!

In the meantime, do us a favour and add "Sanctuary: Shattered Sun" to your Steam wishlist. We appreciate your support more than words can say. And for all the latest news, join us on our [url=https://discord.gg/sanctuaryshatteredsun]Discord Here[/url]. We love to chat and answer any questions you might have.

Thanks for being part of our journey. We can't wait for you to dive into the game with us when its out!
